lists.content:
• Build trusted technical partnerships with strategic hardware manufacturers, including companies developing connected audio products.

  • Lead technical integration projects from planning through launch, helping partners successfully adopt Spotify's Core Playback SDK.

  • Collaborate with engineering, product and cross-functional teams to align priorities, remove blockers and deliver high-quality partner experiences.

  • Drive technical discussions, architecture reviews, workshops and implementation planning with both internal and external stakeholders.

  • Write clear technical proposals, RFCs and design documentation that help engineering teams make informed decisions.

  • Monitor project health, proactively identify risks and coordinate solutions across multiple engineering teams.

  • Investigate and resolve complex SDK, API and integration challenges, contributing code when appropriate.

  • Help improve the tools, processes and developer experience that enable partners to build with Spotify more effectively.

  • Contribute to the long-term evolution of Spotify's hardware platform by identifying opportunities to simplify integrations and scale partner success.

• You have a strong foundation in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related technical discipline.

  • You have 5+ years of experience working in software engineering, partner engineering, developer relations, solutions engineering, or a similar technical role.

  • You are experienced with software development, SDKs, APIs, distributed systems or embedded technologies.

  • You can comfortably read, understand, and contribute to production code while discussing technical architecture with engineers and technical partners.

  • You have experience working across organizational boundaries and building strong relationships with both engineering teams and external partners.

  • You know how to navigate ambiguity, prioritize effectively, and keep complex technical initiatives moving forward.

  • You communicate technical concepts clearly, adapting your approach for different audiences without losing technical depth.

  • Experience with consumer electronics, connected devices, smart home products, audio platforms or hardware certification is valuable.

  • Experience writing technical specifications, architecture proposals or RFCs is an advantage.

• This role is based in Stockholm.

  • We offer you the flexibility to work where you work best! There will be some in person meetings, but still allows for flexibility to work from home.

descriptionPlain:
The Personalization team makes deciding what to play next easier and more enjoyable for every listener. From Blend to Discover Weekly, we’re behind some of Spotify’s most-loved features. We built them by understanding the world of music and podcasts better than anyone else. Join us and you’ll keep millions of users listening by making great recommendations to each and every one of them.

• You have experience in product quality, evaluation, data curation or a closely related field where human judgment is used to assess model or product performance.

  • You have strong judgment and can maintain a consistent quality bar while balancing different product requirements, markets and stakeholder perspectives.

• This role is based in New York or Los Angeles.
  • We offer you the flexibility to work where you work best! There will be some in person meetings, but still allows for flexibility to work from home.

description:
We are looking for a Senior Revenue Accountant to join our global Revenue Accounting operations team supporting the Advertising Revenue segment, including Programmatic, Direct-Sold, Podcast, and Emerging Ad Products. This role sits within the Order-to-Cash (OTC) process and is responsible for driving accounting operations across Spotify's multi-billion dollar advertising business as it scales globally.

The Revenue Accounting team is a central partner to Spotify's Advertising business, working at the intersection of Finance, Engineering, and Sales to ensure accurate financial reporting while building scalable processes that support rapid growth and new revenue streams. This role offers exposure to a wide range of cross-functional teams and strategic initiatives.

lists.content:
• Coordinate accounting across Spotify’s Advertising Revenue business, including Programmatic, Direct-Sold, Podcast, and Emerging Ad Products.
  • Execute and review month-end close activities, including revenue and deferred revenue journal entries, account reconciliations, and fluctuation analyses.
  • Help ensure accurate and timely advertising financial reporting in accordance with International Financial Reporting Standards (IFRS) and Sarbanes-Oxley (SOX) control requirements.
  • Identify opportunities to improve how we work and partner with Engineering and business stakeholders to scope, test, and implement scalable accounting processes and system improvements.
  • Develop and refine revenue accounting processes for new advertising revenue streams, ad formats, platform integrations, and partnerships.
  • Partner with Technical Accounting, Finance, Legal, Sales, Sales Operations, FP&A, Accounts Receivable, Tax, Financial Engineering, and other teams on accounting and systems initiatives.
  • Prepare support for internal and external audits, assess accounting risks, and test system releases that affect advertising revenue reporting.
  • Support acquisitions, ERP and other system implementations, and special projects related to Spotify’s evolving advertising business.

• You have 4+ years of experience in revenue accounting, accounting operations, general ledger accounting, or public accounting, ideally within digital advertising, ad tech, digital media, entertainment, or another business operating at scale.
  • You have a bachelor’s degree in Accounting or equivalent higher education; CPA or CA credentials are a plus.
  • You understand IFRS, revenue recognition principles, and accounting controls, with exposure to ITGC and/or SOX environments.
  • You have experience working with NetSuite or a comparable ERP system such as Oracle or SAP.
  • You are comfortable working with data and systems; experience with SQL, BigQuery, or AI-enabled tools is a plus.
  • You bring strong analytical and problem-solving skills and can balance attention to detail with an understanding of the bigger picture.
  • You can manage multiple priorities and deliver high-quality work against deadlines, including during month-, quarter-, and year-end close.
  • You enjoy collaborating across teams and time zones and bring curiosity and adaptability to a changing business and technology environment.

• This role is based in New York.
  • We offer you the flexibility to work where you work best! There will be some in person meetings, but still allows for flexibility to work from home.
  • We ask that you come into the office 2–3 days per week.

description:
The Platform team creates the technology that enables Spotify to learn quickly and scale easily, enabling rapid growth in our users and our business around the globe. Spanning many disciplines, we work to make the business work; creating the infrastructure, tooling, frameworks, and capabilities needed to welcome a billion customers.

Enterprise AI builds and operates the internal AI platform layer that supports Spotifiers across the company. We’re helping evolve AI tooling into reliable infrastructure that teams can use in their day-to-day work. Our team builds the connective tissue between AI models and Spotify’s internal systems, with a focus on secure access, governance, identity, integrations, and dependable AI infrastructure.

lists.content:
• Design, build, and operate secure enterprise AI platform capabilities that connect AI models, agents, tools, and Spotify’s internal systems.
  • Own major workstreams across our enterprise AI infrastructure, including our Model Context Protocol (MCP) gateway and enterprise context capabilities, from technical design through launch and operation.
  • Build reliable backend services, APIs, and integrations that enable AI-powered experiences across Spotify’s digital workplace.
  • Help develop scalable approaches to AI governance, including identity-aware access, permissions, auditing, policy enforcement, and managing risks associated with third-party AI-enabled tools.
  • Design, build, test, and evaluate agentic systems and workflows that help Spotifiers access information and accomplish tasks effectively.
  • Take operational ownership of the services and components you build, balancing speed, reliability, security, and long-term maintainability.
  • Partner with engineers and stakeholders across Spotify to identify opportunities, make thoughtful technical tradeoffs, and turn emerging AI needs into scalable platform capabilities.
  • Contribute to engineering practices, knowledge sharing, and AI fluency as we learn how to operate enterprise AI infrastructure at Spotify scale.

• You have strong software engineering fundamentals and experience building, testing, debugging, and operating reliable backend systems.
  • You are experienced with backend languages such as Python, Go, or similar and are comfortable designing APIs and integrations across complex systems.
  • You understand software architecture and how services, APIs, enterprise tools, and user-facing experiences fit together.
  • You have experience with identity and authentication concepts and technologies such as OAuth, SAML, or SCIM.
  • You have experience working with cloud infrastructure; familiarity with Google Cloud Platform is valuable.
  • You are comfortable navigating ambiguity, creating clarity, and independently making thoughtful technical tradeoffs.
  • You care about operational ownership and building dependable infrastructure that other teams and employees can rely on.
  • You enjoy experimentation, iteration, knowledge sharing, and continuous learning in a collaborative engineering environment.
  • Experience with enterprise SaaS or platform engineering, or with LLM integration patterns such as tool use, function calling, agentic workflows, or systems-level prompt engineering, will help you make an impact in this role.

• This role is based in New York.
  • We offer you the flexibility to work where you work best! There will be some in person meetings, but still allows for flexibility to work from home.

descriptionPlain:
We design Spotify’s consumer experience—end to end, moment to moment, across every screen, platform, and partner integration. Our mission is to make listening feel effortless, personal, and joyful for billions of users around the world. That means turning complexity into clarity across hundreds of touchpoints—from our mobile and desktop apps to the smart speakers, TVs, cars, and integrations where Spotify shows up every day. If it touches a consumer, we shape it. We bring deep insight into human behavior, design, and technology to craft experiences that feel intuitive, expressive, and unmistakably Spotify.
 
At Spotify, we’re building the best way to experience audio and video — everywhere, every time. As listening and watching on TV continues to grow, we’re investing deeply in native, video-first playback experiences that are fast, reliable, and feel effortless.
 
The Native Playback team sits at the heart of Spotify’s TV strategy. We integrate Spotify’s playback experience with the native players and media frameworks available on each platform. Our work happens close to the system — where performance, reliability, and quality truly matter — and directly impacts how millions of people experience Spotify every day.

lists.content:
• Design, build, and evolve the C++ integration layer that powers Spotify’s audio and video playback on TV devices running our new Rust runtime
  • Integrate Spotify’s playback experience with platform-native media frameworks such as AVPlayer, ExoPlayer, or equivalent TV player stacks
  • Own critical playback areas including buffering strategies, playback state handling, A/V synchronization, adaptive bitrate configuration, track selection, and rendering paths
  • Debug complex performance and reliability issues across multiple layers — from application logic to OS-level frameworks and hardware acceleration
  • Partner closely with Playback platform teams and device teams to ensure shared APIs and designs translate cleanly into real-world TV implementations
  • Improve test coverage, tooling, and observability to detect regressions and speed up iteration cycles
  • Contribute to thoughtful technical design discussions and raise the bar for playback quality through code reviews and knowledge sharing

• You have strong of experience building low-level systems in C++, ideally within video, media, or playback domains
  • You have hands-on experience integrating native playback frameworks such as AVPlayer, ExoPlayer, vendor SDKs, or similar media stacks
  • You have a deep understanding of video playback fundamentals including codecs, streaming formats, adaptive bitrate (ABR), buffering behavior, and A/V synchronization trade-offs
  • You are comfortable working close to the OS and media framework layer and diagnosing issues that span multiple system boundaries
  • You have experience contributing to the design and evolution of scalable technical systems across platforms
  • You are confident debugging performance and reliability issues using logs, traces, profilers, and system diagnostics tools
  • You collaborate effectively across teams and communicate technical trade-offs clearly
  • You care deeply about delivering reliable, high-quality playback experiences for millions of users

• This role is based in London or Stockholm.
  • We offer you the flexibility to work where you work best. While some in-person collaboration is expected, you’ll also have the option to work from home.

  • Define and influence technical strategy across organizational boundaries and bring other senior engineers along in executing it
  • Collaborate with engineering, product and design leaders across the Experience Mission and beyond to identify shared opportunities, align technical direction and reduce duplication
  • Shape how AI transforms the software development lifecycle and pioneer AI-native workflows and capabilities that bridge engineering, product, and design

• You have deep experience designing, building and operating distributed systems that serve users at scale
  • You have a strong track record of technical leadership — influencing and shaping architecture decisions across teams, and driving organizational change in how software gets built
  • You thrive in complex, ambiguous problem spaces and can identify where technical investment will create the greatest leverage across teams and systems
  • You care deeply about reliable, high-quality user experiences powered by data and personalization
  • You actively explore how AI reshapes how we build, not just what we build, and can turn emerging capabilities into practical improvements in how teams work
  • You bring a thoughtful, collaborative, inclusive mindset and actively contribute to a positive team culture

text: Senior Staff Engineer - Platform & Partner Experience
descriptionBody:
We design Spotify's consumer experience — end to end, moment to moment, across every screen, platform, and partner integration. Our mission is to make listening feel effortless, personal, and joyful for billions of users around the world. That means turning complexity into clarity across hundreds of touchpoints — from our mobile and desktop apps to the smart speakers, TVs, cars, and integrations where Spotify shows up every day. If it touches a consumer, we shape it. We bring deep insight into human behavior, design, and technology to craft experiences that feel intuitive, expressive, and unmistakably Spotify.

Platform & Partner Experience (PPX) sits within the Experience Mission, shaping how Spotify shows up across devices, platforms, and partner ecosystems. We build the foundations that power seamless integrations — from smart speakers to cars to AI agents — while ensuring every interaction feels personal, reliable, and unmistakably Spotify. 

As a Senior Staff Engineer, you'll advance how our systems power partner experiences at scale, tackling complex challenges that span teams, systems and organizational boundaries. You will work closely with platform, infrastructure, and product teams across the company to create shared foundations, streamline our architecture and unlock new experiences for our users and partners.

description:
Spotify’s Global Organic Social team is responsible for how Spotify shows up across its owned social channels, connecting fans to the music, podcasts, audiobooks, and features they love.

We’re looking for a Social Strategy Manager, Brand Social to work across some of Spotify’s highest-impact global marketing initiatives including beloved campaigns like Wrapped and Fan Life, trending cultural moments like award shows and sports events, and integrated partnerships with other global media brands. 

You’ll drive social strategy for multiple cross-functional campaigns, working closely within a large, multidisciplinary team including Creative, Comms, Entertainment Partnerships, Paid Media, and more. You'll help shape integrated campaigns from the outset, translating marketing priorities into channel-native social strategies and making the strategic decisions that determine how ideas come to life across social.

This role requires equal parts strategic thinking, online understanding, creative instinct, relationship building, and operational excellence. You must love balancing long-term planning with the agility required to jump on real-time opportunities.

lists.content:
• Own end-to-end social strategy across high-impact global brand campaigns, strategic partnerships, flagship programs, and cultural moments, from development and launch through post-campaign learning.
  • Translate integrated marketing strategies into social-first approaches that feel native to each platform while supporting broader marketing and business objectives.
  • Lead multiple complex social workstreams from brief through execution, creating clarity around timelines, deliverables, approvals, dependencies, and decisions across internal teams and agency partners.
  • Shape social briefs and collaborate with internal creative teams and external agencies throughout creative development, providing actionable feedback and ensuring final work is strategically sound, social-first, and meets Spotify’s quality bar.
  • Partner across Brand, Creative, Comms, Marketing, Partner Marketing, Paid Media, and external agencies to develop integrated campaigns, co-marketing activations, and cultural partnerships.
  • Identify opportunities for Spotify to authentically participate in culture and develop proactive editorial programming that keeps Spotify relevant between major marketing moments.
  • Lead social content-capture strategy for live events and experiential activations, identifying real-time storytelling opportunities and partnering with creators, talent, and production teams on social-first content.
  • Partner with Legal and Communications to navigate approvals and sensitive issues so brand storytelling can be both timely and responsible.
  • Stay close to platform evolution, creator trends, internet culture, and emerging audience behaviors, identifying opportunities for Spotify to innovate.
  • Develop frameworks, playbooks, and best practices that strengthen the quality and consistency of social strategy across Brand Social.
  • Define success metrics with analytics partners, evaluate campaign and always-on performance, and turn learnings into stronger future strategies.
  • Champion social internally, helping partners understand platform behavior, audience expectations, social best practices, and the role social plays throughout an integrated marketing campaign.
  • Present strategic concepts, go-to-market plans, recommendations, and campaign results to stakeholders, including senior leaders and external partners.

• You have 7+ years of experience in owned and earned social media strategy, social marketing, or a related strategic role for global consumer, entertainment, technology, or media brands.
  • You have led social strategy for integrated marketing campaigns with multiple internal and external stakeholders, balancing business objectives with platform-native creativity.
  • You can turn strategy into an executable plan and drive complex, cross-functional work from ambiguity through delivery.
  • You understand how social contributes throughout the marketing funnel and how campaigns can evolve beyond launch into ongoing audience participation.
  • You have strong editorial instincts and can balance long-term strategic planning with thoughtful real-time decision-making.
  • You understand internet culture and can distinguish between fleeting trends and meaningful cultural opportunities that make sense for a brand.
  • You understand the audiences, formats, and behaviors across platforms including Instagram, TikTok, X, Reddit, Threads, YouTube, WhatsApp, and emerging social channels.
  • You build effective relationships and can influence partners across marketing, creative, legal, communications, agencies, and senior leadership.
  • You have experience guiding agency partners through briefing, creative development, production, and execution while maintaining a high creative bar.
  • You are comfortable using social analytics to establish KPIs, interpret performance, and inform strategic decisions.
  • You can communicate strategic recommendations clearly to senior stakeholders and help large, cross-functional groups move toward shared goals.
  • You can move between long-term planning and same-day opportunities while maintaining sound judgment and quality.
  • You care about creating brand social that contributes meaningfully to culture rather than simply interrupting it.

• This role can be based in Los Angeles, CA or New York, NY

  • We offer you the flexibility to work where you work best! There will be some in-person meetings, but still allows for flexibility to work from home. We ask that you come in 2-3 times per week.

descriptionPlain:
The Platform team creates the technology that enables Spotify to learn quickly and scale easily, enabling rapid growth in our users and our business around the globe. Spanning many disciplines, we work to make the business work; creating the infrastructure, tooling, frameworks, and capabilities needed to welcome a billion customers.
Spotify's Financial Engineering (FinE) organization ensures that as Spotify grows, our financial systems grow with it. We build the infrastructure and tooling that finance teams across the company depend on to track revenue accurately, report reliably, and reconcile at scale.
The Oracles team sits at the heart of Spotify's financial infrastructure, building the data pipelines and backend services that power our subledger and accounting lifecycle. As part of a broader Financial Engineering initiative, we're standardizing and scaling how accounting data flows across Spotify. You'll partner with engineers, finance teams, and product managers to build reliable, scalable systems that simplify complex financial processes.
We're looking for a Software Engineer who enjoys building reliable, data-intensive systems. You'll help shape the future of Spotify's financial data platform by designing robust data models, developing scalable backend services, and building high-volume data pipelines that power critical financial workflows.

lists.content:
• Build, operate, and evolve scalable Scio data pipelines on Google Cloud Platform that process high-volume financial data with accuracy and reliability.
  • Develop and enhance Java backend services that power integrations across Spotify's financial ecosystem.
  • Design and evolve data models and datasets that support accounting, reconciliation, financial reporting, and operational insights.
  • Build and improve integrations with external financial systems to bring critical financial data into Spotify's financial ecosystem.
  • Partner closely with Finance, Product, and Engineering teams to translate accounting requirements into reliable, scalable technical solutions.
  • Improve the scalability, observability, and resilience of financial data pipelines and backend services.
  • Contribute to engineering best practices through continuous delivery, automated testing, monitoring, and thoughtful code reviews.
  • Help drive technical decisions that improve the long-term maintainability of Spotify's financial engineering platform.

• You have 3+ years of professional experience building backend systems and data-intensive applications.
  • You are experienced with Scala or Java and at least one distributed data processing framework such as Scio, Apache Beam, Spark, or Flink.
  • You know how to design and build reliable backend services and scalable data pipelines that support business-critical workflows.
  • You have experience designing data models that enable accurate, high-volume financial processes.
  • You have worked with workflow orchestration platforms such as Flyte, Airflow, or similar technologies.
  • You care deeply about engineering fundamentals, including continuous delivery, automated testing, monitoring, and writing production-quality code.
  • You enjoy collaborating with cross-functional partners and translating complex business requirements into elegant technical solutions.
  • Experience working within financial, accounting, or other regulated data domains is a plus.
  • A Bachelor's degree or higher in Computer Science or a related field is a plus.

• This role is based in Toronto.
  • We offer you the flexibility to work where you work best! There will be some in-person meetings, while still allowing flexibility to work from home.

description:
The Experience team designs Spotify’s consumer experience—end to end, moment to moment, across every screen, platform, and partner integration. Our mission is to make listening feel effortless, personal, and joyful for billions of users around the world. That means turning complexity into clarity across hundreds of touchpoints—from our mobile and desktop apps to the smart speakers, TVs, cars, and integrations where Spotify shows up every day. If it touches a consumer, we shape it. We bring deep insight into human behavior, design, and technology to craft experiences that feel intuitive, expressive, and unmistakably Spotify.

The Content Intelligence Product Area is a core part of Spotify’s Content Platform within the Experience mission. We build systems that create deep, machine-readable understanding of content across audio, video, text, and images before it reaches users. This enables automation, safety, and entirely new product experiences. Our work powers content enrichment, quality analysis, annotation platforms, and scalable intelligence systems that allow teams across Spotify to build without needing direct content understanding expertise.

We’re now looking for a Staff Engineer to help build and scale foundational infrastructure powering content understanding across Spotify. This role sits at the intersection of backend systems, ML infrastructure, distributed data systems, and AI-enabled platform capabilities. You’ll help shape infrastructure strategy across the product area while partnering with senior engineers, product leaders, and cross-functional teams to execute on long-term technical investments.

lists.content:
• Lead the design and evolution of data, backend and ML infrastructure systems powering Spotify’s content intelligence capabilities

  • Build scalable infrastructure for multimodal content processing across audio, video, text, and image understanding pipelines

  • Partner closely with Product Managers, Engineering Managers, and senior engineers to shape technical strategy across the Content Intelligence Product Area

  • Drive architectural decisions across distributed systems, ML infrastructure, data processing platforms, and platform reliability

  • Improve infrastructure supporting AI and LLM-enabled workflows, including podcast and audiobook transcript processing, metadata enrichment, and content understanding systems

  • Develop reliable and cost-efficient systems for high-throughput content processing and real-time intelligence use cases

  • Collaborate across organizational boundaries to drive alignment, technical quality, and long-term platform investments

  • Mentor engineers and contribute to raising the engineering bar across the organization

• You have extensive experience building and scaling large-scale backend and infrastructure systems in distributed environments

  • You have strong technical judgment and can balance scalability, reliability, cost, and product needs effectively

  • You have strong programming experience in Java, Python, and/or Scala

  • You understand the challenges of building systems that process high-volume multimedia or real-time workloads

  • You have worked with systems and products that use AI and LLMs at large scale and can demonstrate direct experience in building such products. You can demonstrate a good understanding of the quality scale and cost trade-offs of these technologies.

  • You are comfortable operating in ambiguous, fast-moving environments and helping shape technical direction from the ground up

  • You communicate effectively across engineering, product, and leadership stakeholders

  • You have experience leading complex technical initiatives that span multiple teams or organizational areas

  • You care deeply about collaboration, mentorship, and creating alignment across teams

  • Exposure to search infrastructure, recommendation systems, or audio processing systems is a strong plus

  • Experience working in startup environments or early-stage product areas where ownership and adaptability are critical is highly valued

• This role is based in London or Stockholm

  • We offer you the flexibility to work where you work best! There will be some in person meetings, but still allows for flexibility to work from home.

We design Spotify’s consumer experience - end to end, moment to moment, across every screen, platform, and partner integration. The Content Platform team powers the full lifecycle of content across music, podcasts, audiobooks, and emerging formats at Spotify. We ensure that everything from licensed catalog to user-generated content is trusted, safe, and high quality for millions of listeners worldwide. Our systems are responsible for how content is ingested, understood, enriched, governed, and distributed across the platform. As the scale and diversity of content continues to grow—driven by advances in AI and new creation tools—we’re building intelligent systems that can evaluate, manage, and route content reliably at global scale.

We’re seeking a Staff Machine Learning Engineer to build and scale foundational ML systems that power content understanding across Spotify. In this role, you’ll work on systems that generate deep, machine-readable understanding of content across audio, video, text, and images—enabling automation, improving quality, and unlocking new product experiences. This work is central to delivering safe, high-quality, and differentiated experiences for millions of listeners and creators worldwide.

lists.content:
• Build and scale machine learning systems that generate deep understanding of content across modalities

  • Develop models for classification, tagging, semantic understanding, and content enrichment

  • Create high quality content enrichment at scale using LLMs and agentic systems.

  • Design systems that make content intelligence signals available to downstream teams and products

  • Improve automation for content quality, safety, and metadata enrichment at scale

  • Collaborate with product, policy, and engineering teams to translate content intelligence into user impact

  • Contribute to evaluation frameworks, data pipelines, and annotation systems

  • Support rapid experimentation to prototype and launch new types of content signals

  • Help improve system reliability, scalability, and performance across large datasets

• You have experience building and deploying machine learning systems in production

  • You are comfortable working with ML frameworks such as PyTorch, TensorFlow, or similar

  • You have experience working with large datasets and care about data quality and evaluation

  • You are interested in or have worked with multimodal machine learning

  • You understand how to design systems that balance automation with quality and user experience

  • You are comfortable working on complex problems with evolving requirements

  • You think in systems and understand how models connect to product outcomes

  • You communicate clearly and work well across technical and non-technical teams

• This role is based in New York, NY

  • We offer you the flexibility to work where you work best! There will be some in person meetings, but still allows for flexibility to work from home.

The Music Mission team owns Spotify’s end to end proposition for music creators and the experiences they create for fans. The team is dedicated to building tools and services to enable creation, promotion, expression, and monetization at scale.
The DISCO Product Area is focused on building promotional tools that help artists reach more fans. Our products serve artists at scale through Spotify for Artists, and we’re building on the momentum of Discovery Mode to help artists and their teams find new listeners when it matters most. As a Staff Machine Learning Engineer, you’ll help shape the Machine Learning technical strategy for this high-impact area, partnering across engineering, product, data science, research, and design to create tools that help artists grow their audiences while supporting Spotify’s core business.
description:
The Music Mission team owns Spotify’s end to end proposition for music creators and the experiences they create for fans. The team is dedicated to building tools and services to enable creation, promotion, expression, and monetization at scale.

The DISCO Product Area is focused on building promotional tools that help artists reach more fans. Our products serve artists at scale through Spotify for Artists, and we’re building on the momentum of Discovery Mode to help artists and their teams find new listeners when it matters most. As a Staff Machine Learning Engineer, you’ll help shape the Machine Learning technical strategy for this high-impact area, partnering across engineering, product, data science, research, and design to create tools that help artists grow their audiences while supporting Spotify’s core business.

lists.content:
• Help define and drive the Machine Learning engineering strategy for Discovery Mode and related royalty programs, translating product goals into scalable technical solutions.
  • Design, build, evaluate, ship, and refine production Machine Learning systems through hands-on development.
  • Provide technical leadership across complex ML initiatives, helping teams make thoughtful architectural and engineering decisions while balancing near- and long-term priorities.
  • Collaborate with user research, design, data science, product management, and engineering to build new product capabilities that strengthen connections between artists and fans.
  • Prototype new approaches and turn successful ideas into reliable, scalable solutions for Spotify for Artists customers.
  • Drive experimentation, optimization, testing, and tooling that improve the quality, reliability, and effectiveness of our Machine Learning systems.
  • Partner with engineers and Machine Learning practitioners across Spotify, including Music Tech Research and Personalization, to explore and develop new approaches to music promotion.
  • Help grow the technical capabilities of the broader engineering community through mentorship, knowledge sharing, and strong engineering practices.

• You have deep experience with Machine Learning and a strong understanding of Machine Learning algorithms, modeling approaches, evaluation, and experimentation.
  • You have hands-on experience designing and implementing production Machine Learning systems at scale using languages such as Python, Java, Scala, or similar.
  • You can set technical direction for complex ML problems while remaining close to implementation and delivery.
  • You care about reliable software, data-informed development, disciplined experimentation, and building systems that perform effectively at scale.
  • You enjoy leading technically complex projects from idea through production and working closely with teammates and partners to deliver meaningful outcomes.
  • You are comfortable navigating ambiguity, evaluating trade-offs, and creating clarity on high-impact initiatives.
  • You communicate technical decisions and risks clearly and can build alignment with senior technical leaders and cross-functional partners.
  • You care about creating products that better serve artists and their teams, and you take a collaborative, team-first approach to helping others do their best work.

• We offer you the flexibility to work where you work best! For this role, you can be within the North America region as long as we have a work location.
  • This team operates within the Eastern time zone for collaboration.

description:
The Personalization team makes deciding what to play next easier and more enjoyable for every listener. From Blend to Discover Weekly, we're behind some of Spotify's most-loved features. We built them by understanding the world of music and podcasts better than anyone else. Join us and you'll keep millions of users listening by making great recommendations to each and every one of them.


Surfaces Moments is a ML team within the Personalization Mission focused on creating moment-based experiences across Spotify surfaces. The team owns and evolves the experiences that help listeners quickly connect with the content that matters most to them, including the Home Shortcuts experience and the underlying intelligence that powers it. By combining cutting-edge machine learning, recommendation systems, and product thinking, the team delivers highly relevant, personalized experiences to millions of listeners around the world.


As a Staff Machine Learning Engineer, you will help shape the future of personalized discovery and engagement at Spotify. You'll work at the intersection of recommendation systems, large language models, and production-scale machine learning infrastructure to build experiences that delight users and drive meaningful impact. This role is ideal for someone who enjoys taking models from research to production, driving technical direction in ambiguous problem spaces, and solving complex personalization challenges at global scale.

lists.content:
• Own and improve the machine learning models and systems that power the Home feed, including the Shortcuts experience.

  • Design, build, and ship personalized recommendations that serve millions of Spotify listeners globally.

  • Build content recommendation systems for emerging agentic and AI-powered user experiences.

  • Train, fine-tune, evaluate, and optimize large language models using techniques such as supervised fine-tuning (SFT), distillation, and parameter-efficient training approaches.

  • Partner closely with product managers, engineers, data scientists, and designers to define and execute experimentation strategies.

  • Drive A/B testing, monitoring, model evaluation, and continuous optimization of recommendation quality, reliability, and cost efficiency.

  • Improve ML platform capabilities, data pipelines, and production systems that support personalization at Spotify scale.

  • Drive technical direction in ambiguous problem spaces and contribute to the long-term architecture of personalization systems.

  • Mentor and support other machine learning engineers, helping raise the bar across the team.

• You have 8+ years of experience building and deploying machine learning systems in production environments.

  • You have deep expertise in recommendation systems, ranking models, personalization, or large-scale content discovery platforms.

  • You have strong proficiency in Python and hands-on experience building machine learning systems with PyTorch.

  • You are experienced with large language model training, fine-tuning, evaluation, and optimization techniques including SFT, distillation, and LoRA.

  • You have worked with large-scale inference systems and understand the challenges of latency, reliability, and cost optimization.

  • You care deeply about creating high-quality user experiences through thoughtful application of machine learning.

  • You communicate effectively across technical and non-technical audiences, and you influence technical decisions beyond your immediate team

  • You know how to design, execute, and interpret online experiments and A/B tests to improve user outcomes.

  • You have experience operating distributed machine learning workloads using technologies such as Ray, FSDP, HSDP, or similar frameworks.

  • You are experienced building and maintaining data pipelines and orchestration workflows using technologies such as Flyte, Airflow, BigQuery, and cloud-based storage platforms.

• We offer you the flexibility to work where you work best! For this role, you can be within the North Americas region as long as we have a work location.

  • This team operates within the Eastern Standard time zone for collaboration.

description:
We are looking for a strategic public policy professional to join Spotify’s Global Government Affairs team in New York City. The Government Affairs team helps Spotify understand the global and local policy landscape, advocates on issues important to our business and users, and works to anticipate and mitigate policy and regulatory risks.

In this role, you’ll work closely with Government Affairs colleagues and teams across Spotify to develop positions on public policy proposals and strategies to advance them. You’ll report to the Director of Government Affairs, US & Canada, with a particular focus on state and local policy.

lists.content:
• Design and execute policymaker engagement strategies that strengthen Spotify’s relationships across priority jurisdictions, with a focus on New York City, New York State, and other key states.
  • Develop expertise on public policy issues with commercial and reputational importance to Spotify, including tax, artificial intelligence, content moderation, and emerging policy matters.
  • Identify and assess priority state and local public policy issues affecting Spotify, and partner with your manager and US Government Affairs colleagues to develop effective advocacy strategies.
  • Collaborate with teams across Spotify, including Legal, Communications, Social Impact, Product, Compliance, and Trust & Safety, to understand business priorities, develop clear policy narratives, and shape approaches to key policy issues.
  • Build relationships and partnerships with external organizations, including trade associations and civil society organizations, to advance engagement and thought leadership on priority public policy issues.
  • Represent Spotify with policymakers, government officials, industry peers, and other external stakeholders in support of the company’s policy priorities.

• You have 5+ years of experience developing and implementing public policy or government affairs strategies and working with policymakers or other public policy stakeholders.
  • You have experience working in government, the private sector, a trade association, or a related public policy environment.
  • You have built strong relationships with policymakers and understand how to develop trusted relationships with officials in New York City, New York State, and other priority jurisdictions.
  • You have experience developing public policy strategies related to the technology sector and can translate complex policy developments into clear business implications.
  • You have experience engaging senior government officials, private-sector leaders, and public policy professionals.
  • You can develop and execute effective advocacy strategies while balancing multiple stakeholders and priorities.
  • You communicate clearly in writing and conversation and can adapt your approach for policymakers, business leaders, and cross-functional partners.
  • You build collaborative relationships across functions and levels, approach problems with sound judgment and integrity, and are comfortable operating in a changing policy environment.
  • You are able to travel throughout the United States as needed, including occasionally on short notice.

• This is a hybrid role based in our New York City offices (average 2 to 3 days a week required)

  • Working hours? We operate within the EST zone for collaboration.

description:
The Platform team creates the technology that enables Spotify to learn quickly and scale easily, enabling rapid growth in our users and our business around the globe. Spanning many disciplines, we work to make the business work; creating the infrastructure, tooling, frameworks, and capabilities needed to welcome a billion customers.

Want to be part of a billion-dollar business running some of the biggest SaaS installations globally? Spotify is looking for a Systems Manager to lead our Financial Systems Functional Analysis team — a talented group of Functional Analysts and quality specialists responsible for shaping, delivering, and assuring the financial solutions that underpin Spotify's global business.

You’ll join the FinE Alliance within the Platform Mission, partnering closely with Finance teams across Controllership, Tax, Treasury, FP&A, Procurement, and Payroll, as well as Engineering and Operations peers across Financial Engineering. This is a highly collaborative leadership role where you’ll help scale our financial systems capability, drive operational excellence, and enable Spotify’s continued global growth through modern SaaS and engineered solutions.

lists.content:
• Lead, develop, and support a team of Functional Analysts and quality specialists, creating an environment focused on delivery excellence, growth, and collaboration.

  • Own the delivery lifecycle for finance-domain initiatives, from requirements gathering and solution design through testing, stakeholder sign-off, and operational handover.

  • Set the standard for high-quality Functional Analysis across the team, including requirements documentation, solution design, vendor engagement, stakeholder management, and operational readiness.

  • Partner closely with Engineering and Operations teams to ensure seamless delivery across a hybrid SaaS and custom-built ERP ecosystem.

  • Drive strategic initiatives supporting Procure-to-Pay, Order-to-Cash, Record-to-Report, Tax, Treasury, and related global finance processes.

  • Shape solution architecture decisions for complex, cross-functional financial systems initiatives with high business visibility and impact.

  • Foster analytical excellence and act as a trusted bridge between Finance stakeholders and technical teams.

  • Manage vendor relationships across the systems portfolio, including roadmap discussions, escalations, contract reviews, and vendor performance management.

  • Drive continuous improvement initiatives, including opportunities to leverage automation and Generative AI to improve team scalability and delivery efficiency.

  • Define and track team KPIs, delivery metrics, and operational performance indicators to guide prioritization and resourcing decisions.

  • Serve as an escalation point for complex finance systems issues, stakeholder concerns, and vendor-related challenges.

  • Support SOX and ITGC compliance activities, audit readiness, and change management processes across the systems your team delivers and operates.

• You have 8+ years of experience in financial systems delivery, functional analysis, or enterprise applications within large-scale ERP environments such as NetSuite, Oracle, SAP, Workday, or similar platforms.

  • You have 5+ years of people management experience and a strong track record of hiring, developing, and retaining high-performing analysts across multiple seniority levels.

  • You are an experienced coach and mentor who genuinely enjoys helping people grow and succeed.

  • You have led complex finance systems initiatives end-to-end, including requirements gathering, stakeholder alignment, configuration, testing, deployment, and operational adoption.

  • You have deep functional knowledge across enterprise finance processes including Procure-to-Pay (PTP), Order-to-Cash (OTC), Record-to-Report (RTR), Tax, and Treasury operations.

  • You are experienced partnering with senior stakeholders across Finance, Procurement, Tax, Treasury, and FP&A functions in global organizations.

  • You have experience managing SaaS vendor relationships, including roadmap planning, escalations, and contract-related discussions.

  • You understand SOX frameworks and IT General Controls as they relate to ERP and SaaS change management and audit readiness.

  • You are comfortable navigating ambiguity and translating high-level business goals into practical team priorities and delivery plans.

  • You communicate clearly and transparently, building trust across teams and stakeholders.

  • You are experienced working within Agile environments and using tools such as Jira for delivery tracking and prioritization.

  • You bring strong judgment, curiosity, and a continuous improvement mindset to solving complex operational problems.

  • You have experience working with or exploring Generative AI capabilities to improve delivery effectiveness and operational scale.

  • You have experience supporting both project delivery and operational systems administration responsibilities within a single team environment.

  • You may have an accounting qualification such as CPA, CA, ACCA, or equivalent professional

• This role is based in Toronto.
  • We offer you the flexibility to work where you work best! There will be some in person meetings, but still allows for flexibility to work from home.

description:

We are a team of highly skilled and dedicated colleagues and we offer a challenging and dynamic role in an ever changing environment with the opportunity to take on much responsibility in a rapidly growing international company. Above all, your work will impact the way the world experiences audio.

lists.content:
• Prepare indirect tax returns ensuring they are filed timely and accurate.
  • Calculate indirect taxes and ensure timely payments.
  • Analyze data and transactions to ensure correct reporting.
  • Assist with gathering and analyzing data for indirect tax audits and internal audits.
  • Support in monitoring Indirect Tax rules and regulations all over the world.
  • Coordinate with, and support, Finance and Accounting teams as necessary and assist in processes that involve indirect tax.
  • Assist with new tax registrations where needed.
  • Work with external service providers and foreign tax authorities.
  • Participate in process improvement projects
  • Assist in other tax compliance areas such as digital services tax.
  • Other projects as required.

• University degree with relevant education such as law degree, accounting, CPA, or any combination thereof.
  • Approximately 2 years of relevant tax related work experience.
  • Experience from indirect tax compliance work on a global scale is a big plus.
  • Excellent English skills, both verbally and written. Other language skills are helpful.
  • Experience with financial systems (we use NetSuite): ERPs, consolidation tools and management reporting tools.
  • Strong skills in the Google suite and/or Microsoft Office including the ability to prepare robust models and the ability and desire to learn new software platforms.
  • Strong attention to detail, ability to drive work and assist with process improvements.
  • Self-starter, capable of working independently with strong initiative and flexibility.
  • Comfortable using AI tools to improve efficiency and quality in day-to-day work, with a willingness to explore new ways of applying them. 
  • Intellectually curious, detail oriented, and eager to learn and develop every day.
  • Able to work in a fast paced, informal, and often ambiguous environment.

• This role is based in Stockholm, Sweden.
  • We offer you the flexibility to work where you work best! We ask that you come to the office at least 3 times a week.

descriptionBody:
We are currently looking for a new band member to join the Spotify Tax Team. This new band member will be an Analyst, joining the Global Indirect Tax Team. This position will report into the Senior Manager for Indirect Tax in EMEA and APAC and will be based in Stockholm, Sweden.

In your role, you will focus on compliance and reporting. Spotify reports indirect taxes in more than 90 countries globally and you will be a key member of the team responsible for ensuring the completeness, timeliness and accuracy of Spotify’s global indirect tax compliance obligations. You will work in close collaboration with global tax team members in both Stockholm and New York, and work cross functionally with various accounting and finance teams.

We are a team of highly skilled and dedicated colleagues and we offer a challenging and dynamic role in an ever changing environment with the opportunity to take on much responsibility in a rapidly growing international company. Above all, your work will impact the way the world experiences audio.
